top_signals.title: Data Center QTS Holds Investor Calls Ahead of Possible Debt Sale
top_signals.summary: Subsidiaries of QualityTech LP are holding series of fixed income investor calls ahead of a potential bond offering that would add to this year’s surge in technology deals.
